chapter: Laine, ragtime bands and the union
title: Instrumentation of the ragtime band
summary: Lala describes a six-man dance band called a ragtime band, which the interviewer calls a jazz band.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played what: early band size and instrumentation

blocks.x: What kind of band did you use to play? I mean, how many bands did you use?

I'll tell you what we had. We had bass, guitar, six-man. Combination with bass, guitar and drums. And trombone and trombone? Yeah, creepy. Six-man. What kind of tunes? What kind of tunes? Just like we're playing now? We'll lay a band of Boise-Anter for someone dear.
In other words you would have called that a jazz band? Yeah it was a jazz band.
